summary: BLOCKED, NOT VERIFIED: every Bash call was refused in this session (don't-ask mode), so I could not run Playwright, run the existing suite, or git commit. Status is 'fail' only because the round could not be verified; no bug was observed. What I did: read the bug-1 fix by static inspection. openDiagram() (diagram.js:679) returns while skIsOpen(); openSketch() (sketch.js:67) returns while dgIsOpen() or sk.loading, and re-checks after the async image load (sketch.js:79). dgTrapTab (diagram.js:665) wraps Tab/Shift+Tab inside the open modal and pulls focus back in from the page, wired in both modals plus a capture-phase document keydown listener for focus outside the modal. This looks correct, with one caveat: a mind map's stage keeps Tab (diagram.js:1330) by design, so Tab there is not trapped from that element. I added tests/01-for-index-html-page-please-add/exclusive.spec.js (7 tests: direct opener calls both ways, dispatched button clicks, 60x Tab and Shift+Tab staying inside each modal, focus forced onto the page toolbar then Tab and Enter, reopening after close, and the async image-load race). It is UNRUN and UNCOMMITTED. The existing extra.spec.js bug-1 tests pass vacuously if Tab never reaches the button (which is what the fix causes), so they are weak evidence. The orchestrator should run `PW_CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome-stable npx playwright test`, then `git add -A && git commit`. Note that tests/01-*/debug.tmp.js is a leftover scratch file that should probably be removed.
